trackers.emptyState: A tracker is a connection to OpenProject or Redmine that you export time to. Its API key stays in this browser.
trackers.directBrowserAccessHelp: Some tracker installations block connections from other websites. Turn this off if this tracker cannot be reached from the browser; the OSI browser extension will then be required. The technical setting is CORS.
trackers.extensionStatusAvailable: The OSI extension is available for this tracker.
trackers.extensionSetupGuidance: Install the OSI Time Tracker extension for Chrome or Edge, approve this website and tracker destination, then recheck. Remote actions stay disabled until the extension is ready.
trackers.secretHelp: Stays only in this browser and is never sent to the OSI server. You can add it later.

trackerImport.description: Fetches your time logs from this tracker into projects by remote project. Logs imported before are skipped.
trackerImport.rangeRequired: Enter a start and end date.
trackerImport.rangeInverted: The start date must be before the end date.
trackerImport.unscopedHelp: A project without a remote project gets no logs automatically. Pick it by hand in the Mapping step, or set its remote project when editing the project.
trackerImport.mappingDescription: Choose which project each remote project's logs should go to. Projects with a matching remote project are pre-selected; you can change any of them, including ones with no match.

trackerImport.unmatchedHint: {count} logs were left unassigned and will be skipped. Go back and assign them a project to include them.
trackerImport.missingProjectIdHint: Some logs have no remote project information; update the extension or check the tracker connection to enable routing.
trackerImport.syntheticTimesNote: Entries were placed from 08:00 on each day, after any existing entries. Times are synthetic; durations are exact.

projects.deleteConfirmMessage: “{name}” disappears from the list and can no longer be picked for new entries. Its time entries are kept unchanged.
